headline: Voted 3-0 to enter executive session to review resumes for City Council Budget/Management Analyst applicants, then adjourned directly.
summary: The committee met to screen applicants for the City Council Budget/Management Analyst position. It voted to go into executive session to review resumes and applications, citing an open meeting law exemption, and adjourned directly from that session without reconvening publicly.
decisions: Voted 3-0 to enter Executive Session to review applicant resumes for the Budget/Management Analyst position.

decision_evidence.quote: Rotondo moves to enter Executive Session; Spang seconds; Houseman takes a roll-call vote (Rotondo-yes; Spang-yes; Houseman-yes), and the motion carries 3-0 at 2:03 p.m.
